title: Buck Mulligan
html_source: Buck Mulligan is one of the many characters who reappear in the last section of the chapter: “From the window of the D. B. C. Buck Mulligan gaily, and Haines gravely, gazed down on the viceregal equipage over the shoulders of eager guests, whose mass of forms darkened the chessboard whereon John Howard Parnell looked intently.”
